scope: Corollary 5.6 (Eliminating the missing directions) of the manuscript “Pure-Point Spectrum for the Two-Dimensional Anderson Model at Every Positive Disorder” (preprints/Pure-Point-Spectrum-for-the-Two-Dimensional-Anderson-Model-at-Every-Positive-Disorder-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 261 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 17487e3a2720b36f), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF pages 28-29. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. The quote crosses a page break and includes whatever the extraction places there, such as a page number. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let N = 1 − P on the boundary space. Almost everywhere in the boundary law, the N, N block of T is invertible. Define its Schur matrix and transformed source by b T = PT P − PT N(NT N)−1 NT P, b k = Pk − PT N(NT N)−1 Nk. 28 Then b T is complex symmetric and passive, and b T−1 = PT −1 P, b k = b TPT −1 k, P(T − iP)−1 k = ( b T − i1P )−1b k. In particular ρ = ( b T − i1P )−1b k 2 , and Equation (5.2) controls b T−1 on a set carrying a fixed fraction of this weight.
